title: Bind Terraform secret-provider outputs to Helm values and introduce init-sidecar-proxy-values
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: When customers deploy Redwood Private using both the Terraform modules and the Helm chart, there is a gap where sensitive artifacts (image pull secrets, KMS-backed credentials) produced by Terraform are not consistently wired into Helm values in a documented, idempotent way. This PR provides: 1) a values binding convention that maps Terraform outputs (secretProviderName, kmsKeyAlias, imageMirrorCredentials) into Helm values under .global.terraformBindings, 2) a new init-sidecar-proxy helper container that runs alongside tenant/seed init jobs to perform adaptive preflight network checks, volume prefetch, and lightweight secret hydration with exponential backoff, configurable via values, 3) a strict values.schema.json bump that validates the new binding shape and marks the older .preseed.* keys as deprecated with automated migration hints, 4) small E2E test updates and docs entry linking the Terraform module outputs and Helm values. Checklist: - [x] values schema + docs - [x] helm templates accepting terraformBindings - [x] init-sidecar-proxy image and probe lifecycle - [x] e2e test to assert secret mounting in airgapped flow - [x] integration job on CI updated - [x] migration notes added in values/UPGRADE.md Backwards compatibility: default values leave behavior unchanged; deprecated keys surface warnings in helm template rendering. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut patch release for private-installer helm chart, update terraform module usage examples. Related: ENG-4123 for overall infra binding work.

review_conversation: Liam O'Neill (reviewer): Can we make the binding field name shorter? .global.terraformBindings seems verbose; suggest .global.tf.bindings or a top-level .tfBindings.
Maya Chen (author): Chose .global.terraformBindings to make intent explicit and avoid collisions with existing tf charts; added alias .global.tfBindings in _helpers.tpl for backwards ergonomics.

Priya Ramesh (reviewer): init-sidecar-proxy looks good but we should avoid running network probes in clusters that enforce egress via a proxy. Can we make probes opt-in and add a preflightMode: none|light|full?

Maya Chen (author): Added preflightMode with default 'light' and a helm value to disable probes entirely. Also added clusterProxy detection hook to switch to DNS-only checks when HTTP outbound is blocked.
Jamal Ortega (reviewer): Helm lint flagged template indentation on seed-init-job; please fix and add a unit test for the template rendering path.
Maya Chen (author): Fixed indentation and added a small template rendering test asserting the sidecar is injected when terraformBindings.imagePullSecret is present.
Priya Ramesh (approver): Approved after CI green and docs updated. Note: please coordinate release notes with the private deploy docs team.
Release Bot: Merge queued after passing branch protection checks.
release_notes: Add terraformBindings values to simplify wiring Terraform outputs into the Private Helm chart. Introduce init-sidecar-proxy for adaptive preflight checks and secret hydration. Deprecate .preseed.* keys; see UPGRADE.md for migration steps.
